DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 電話の相手は何を名乗りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Who did the caller claim to be?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の給与担当の手伝いだと言いました。勤務先名も知っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社名を知る電話相手を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: They said they helped the company's payroll staff. They also knew my employer's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the caller who knew your company's name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何を求められましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 銀行の暗証番号です。給与確認に必要と言われ、そこで電話を切りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 暗証番号を要求され切ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My bank PIN. They said it was needed to check my salary, so I hung up at that point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say they requested your PIN and you hung up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号を伝えたり、画面を見せたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you tell them the number or show them your screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。ただ会社名が合っていたので、最初は信じてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 情報未提供と信じた理由を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. But because the company name was correct, I initially believed them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say no information was provided and explain why you believed them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前を知っているだけでは本人とは確認できません。会社の既知の窓口へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Knowing a name alone does not verify someone's identity. Check with a known contact at your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 社内の給与担当へ自分から聞きます。着信の番号に折り返すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既知の社内窓口で確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will contact our payroll staff myself. I will not call back the incoming number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to check through a known internal contact. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 着信時刻や相手の言葉を残してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you kept the call time and what the caller said?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモと履歴があります。暗証番号を言っていないことも、記録に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 履歴を示し未提供情報も記録を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have notes and the call history. Please also record that I did not disclose my PIN.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the call history and ask that undisclosed information be recorded too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。伝えた情報と伝えていない情報を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ask separately about the information you disclosed and did not disclose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いつ頃のお届けをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: When would you like it delivered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 早い方がいいです。でも友人は来週まで出張でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 早い配達希望と相手の不在を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sooner the better. But I remembered my friend is away on business until next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your preference for early delivery and the recipient's absence. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取れる方や日時は確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed who can receive it and when?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人暮らしです。玄関に置いてもらえると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人暮らしと置配の思い込みを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend lives alone. I thought it could be left at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the recipient lives alone and you assumed doorstep delivery was possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の種類と配送方法で取扱いが異なります。置くだけと決めずに確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Handling differs by parcel type and delivery method. Let's check rather than assume it can simply be left there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、友人が戻る日を聞いてから送りたいです。今日は受付を待ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認まで受付を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like to send it after asking when my friend returns. Could you hold off accepting it today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put acceptance on hold until you confirm with the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。送り状はまだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The shipping label has not been finalized yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡できました。来週月曜日に戻るそうです。到着希望の指定ができる範囲を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅日を伝えて指定条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I managed to contact my friend. They return next Monday. I would like to know the conditions for specifying a preferred arrival date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the return date and ask about date-selection conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送日も含め担当からご案内します。希望日は到着の保証とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain, including the dispatch date. A requested date is different from a guarantee of arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を聞いて、受け取れる頃に発送します。今日は箱を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取可能時期に合わせ発送を延期する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hear the guidance and send it around when my friend can receive it. I will take the box home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Postpone dispatch to suit when the recipient can receive it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。決まった日程で改めてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it again according to the schedule you decide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みは、こちらの二枚の請求書についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the transfer for these two invoices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ相手なので、二つの金額を足して一回で送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ相手への二件を合算したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. They are for the same recipient, so I would like to add the two amounts and send one transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to combine two payments to the same recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払いごとの指定は、何と書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: What instructions are written for each payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それぞれ違う請求番号を、依頼人名に付けるように書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの請求番号が異なると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Each says to add a different invoice number to the sender's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the two invoice numbers differ. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一回にまとめると、どちらの番号を使うか確認が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you combine them, you need to confirm which number to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方の番号を続けて入れれば、先方で分かるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両番号を並べて入力すれば照合できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I enter both numbers one after the other, will the recipient be able to identify them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether entering both numbers together allows reconciliation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先方で照合できるかは、こちらでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We cannot determine whether the recipient can reconcile them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認してみます。合算してよいかと、番号の入れ方を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合算可否と番号の入れ方を先方へ確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check with them. I will ask whether combining is allowed and how to enter the numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the recipient whether combining is allowed and how to enter the numbers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。回答があるまで、送金は進めずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please wait without proceeding with the transfer until you receive a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先方から、二件に分けるよう返事が来ました。請求書ごとに金額と番号を合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答に従い請求書ごとに分けて送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: They replied that I should make two separate transfers. I will match the amount and number to each invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will follow the reply and send separately by invoice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一件ずつ、振込先と入力内容を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's check the destination and entered details one payment at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。レシートは要らないと言いましたが、会社へ出すので必要でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 辞退したレシートを必要と申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. I said I did not need the receipt, but I actually need it for my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the receipt you previously declined. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今のお会計の物ですね。お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You mean for the transaction just now. Please wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この机の紙を取ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 机の紙が自分の物か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. May I take the paper on this desk?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the paper on the desk is yours. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それは前のお客様の物です。お客様のお会計を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That belongs to the previous customer. I will check your transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取りません。私は作業用の手袋と水を買いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の紙を取らず購入品を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not take it. I bought work gloves and water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not take someone else's paper; state what you bought. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お支払いは何でされましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードです。支払いの通知はここにあります。時刻も今です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 決済方法と時刻の証拠を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: By card. Here is the payment notification. The time is just now too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show evidence of the payment method and time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照合できました。このレシートがお客様の物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have matched it. This receipt is yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。商品と時刻を見てから受け取ります。次から会計前にお願いしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の取引を照合して受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will check the items and time before accepting it. Next time I will ask before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match your own transaction and receive it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。会社への提出条件もレシートで足りるかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here you are. Please also check whether a receipt is sufficient for your company's submission requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのベンチは今、使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please do not use that bench at the moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乾いているので座れると思いました。「修理中」は掃除とは違うんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 修理表示と座れる見た目の違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is dry, so I thought I could sit. Is “under repair” different from cleaning?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the repair sign versus the appearance of being usable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 部品の確認中で、座ると危険な可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The parts are being checked, and sitting on it could be dangerous.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見た目だけでは分からないんですね。札を外さず離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札を外さず使用をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So you cannot tell just by looking. I will leave without removing the sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Stop using it without removing the sign. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別のベンチをご案内します。少し歩けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will show you another bench. Can you walk a little?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。荷物が重いので、近い所をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重い荷物のため近い席を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My luggage is heavy, so somewhere nearby, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for nearby seating because your luggage is heavy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理棟の前に椅子があります。荷物は通路へ置かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are chairs in front of the management building. Please do not put luggage in the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 椅子の横にまとめます。散歩は休んでから続けるか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を通路外へ置き休憩を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep it together beside the chair. I will decide whether to continue my walk after resting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep luggage off the walkway and prioritize resting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理棟で水も補給できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also refill water at the management building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では先に休みます。修理中のベンチには友人にも座らないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者にも使用禁止を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will rest first. I will tell my friend not to sit on the bench under repair either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your companion that use is prohibited too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。作業中の区画にも入らずお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11231-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please also stay out of the work area as you proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この区間は運転再開の時刻がまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The time for service to resume on this section has not been decided yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ行く途中です。会社の車で迎えに来てもらえるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通勤中で送迎を相談する意向を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am on my way to work. I would like to ask whether the company can send a car to pick me up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are commuting and intend to ask about a pickup. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車で来られる場合は駅前の案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: If a car comes, please also check the information outside the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 迎えは頼めました。ただ出口が二つあります。車に伝える名前はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確定した迎えに伝える出口名を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The pickup has been arranged. But there are two exits. Which exit name should I tell the driver?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask which exit name to give your confirmed pickup. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの出口名です。車が停車できる場所は案内板のこの区画になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the exit name. The area where cars may stop is this section on the information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 改札を出てから歩けますか。反対側から来た人と混ざらないよう現在地も伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今の改札から迎え場所への経路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can I walk there after leaving the ticket gates? I also want to tell them my current location so they do not confuse me with people coming from the opposite side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the route from your current ticket gate to the pickup point. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この改札から出れば、その出口へ進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you leave through this gate, you can head to that exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社へ出口名を送りました。車が着くまでは乗降区画をふさがず待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待ち場所で乗降を妨げないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have sent the exit name to my company. I will wait without blocking the pickup and drop-off area until the car arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not obstruct boarding or alighting while waiting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 建物側でお待ちになり、車が来たら合流してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Wait on the building side and meet the car when it arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。列車を待つ予定から迎えに変更したことも職場へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列車待ちから送迎へ変更を職場に知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will also tell my workplace I changed from waiting for the train to being picked up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your workplace about changing from waiting for the train to a pickup. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気を付けて。改札で切符の扱いが必要なら係員へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care. If your ticket needs to be dealt with at the gate, please show it to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご希望の相談日時を確認できました。予約案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have confirmed your preferred consultation date and time. Here is the booking information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この契約書の原本も、今日置いて帰ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約時に原本を預けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. Should I also leave the original of this contract here today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to leave the original at the time of booking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は予約の受付です。原本を預かる扱いではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today we are accepting your booking. We are not taking custody of originals.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談担当が先に読むと思っていました。資料は当日持参するんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 資料持参は相談当日と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the consultant would read it beforehand. So I bring the documents on the consultation day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that documents are brought on the consultation day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。必要な資料の一覧を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please check the list of required documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一覧に写しとあります。原本しかないので、コピーして持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一覧の写し指定を読んで準備を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The list says a copy. I only have the original, so I will make a copy and bring it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the copy requirement and decide what to prepare. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原本の確認が必要かは、当日の担当にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the staff on the day whether checking the original is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では写しを準備し、原本も自分で持ちます。窓口に置き忘れないようまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写しと原本を本人が管理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will prepare a copy and keep the original with me too. I will gather them together so I do not leave anything at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will manage both the copy and original yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談日時と受付場所もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the consultation time and reception location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この日時と場所ですね。契約書は全部受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約案内と持帰る資料を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: This date, time, and location, correct? I have taken back all the contract documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the booking information and documents to take home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。大切な原本はご自身で保管し、当日お越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please keep the important original yourself and come on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は終わりましたが、ほかに必要な物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your payment is complete. Is there anything else you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ診断書を出すので、領収書と一緒にもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払後に診断書も欲しいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to submit a medical certificate to my company. Can I have it together with the receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a medical certificate after paying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診断書は別の申込みと医師の作成が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: A medical certificate requires a separate application and preparation by the doctor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支払ったら自動で付く物ではないんですね。会社の提出期限は金曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別申込だと理解し提出期限を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is not automatically included when I pay. My company's submission deadline is Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the separate application and state the submission deadline. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作成日数は担当へ確認します。会社の指定用紙はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the preparation time with the staff. Does your company have a specified form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありますが家に置いて来ました。病院の用紙でよいか、会社に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定用紙を家に忘れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, but I left it at home. I will ask my company whether the hospital's form is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you left the specified form at home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な形式が分かってからお申込みいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can apply once you know the required format.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は申込方法と受取までの見込みを知りたいです。金曜日に間に合うと決めず確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申込方法と作成の見込みを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today I would like to know how to apply and the expected time until receipt. I will check without assuming it will be ready by Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to apply and about the expected preparation time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この窓口で用紙と用途を確認します。完成日を保証する案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: This counter will check the form and purpose. This information does not guarantee a completion date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。指定用紙を確認し、提出期限の相談も会社へします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社の形式と期限を確認して申込むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will confirm the specified form and also discuss the submission deadline with my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to confirm the company's format and deadline before applying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付案内をお渡しします。条件が分かったらお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the application guidance. Please bring it when you know the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた定期入れの特徴をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please describe the pass holder you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 茶色で透明の窓があります。朝は改札で使えたのですが、帰りにありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 定期入れの特徴と使用後の不在を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is brown with a clear window. I used it at the gates this morning, but it was missing on the way home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the pass holder and its absence after use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に使った駅と時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the station and time you last used it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝七時、この駅で使いました。その後は会社へ行って、定期入れを見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の改札使用時刻を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At this station at seven this morning. After that I went to work and have not seen the holder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the last time you used it at the gates. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中にはほかに何が入っていましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 交通カードと会社の名刺です。交通カードもここで止めてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身を伝え交通カード停止を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: A transport card and a company business card. Can you block the transport card here too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the contents and ask about blocking the transport card. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紛失届とは別に、発行元へ利用停止方法をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Separately from the lost-property report, please ask the issuer how to suspend use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。会社には名刺の入った物をなくしたと伝え、カードは発行元へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行元への停止と会社への連絡を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will tell my company I lost an item containing a business card, and contact the issuer about the transport card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate contacting the issuer to suspend use from notifying your company. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 定期入れの届出は、この特徴と移動経路で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take the holder's lost-property report based on these features and your route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社から駅までの道も説明します。朝の使用と夕方に気付いた時刻は分けて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用時点と発覚時点を区別し経路を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will also explain the route from my company to the station. I will write separately the morning use and the time I noticed in the evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the use time from the discovery time and explain your route. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。分かる順にお聞きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please tell us in the order you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお受け取りについてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about collecting your parcel, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。明後日から旅行です。帰るまで再配達を待っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行中まで再配達を待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am leaving on a trip the day after tomorrow. Is it all right to wait for redelivery until I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether redelivery can wait through your trip. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保管期限をまず確認しましょう。旅行は何日間ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's first check the storage deadline. How many days will you be away?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一週間です。不在票の期限は旅行の途中になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰宅前に保管期限が来ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One week. The deadline on the missed-delivery notice falls during the trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the storage deadline comes before you return. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰宅まで待てるとは限りません。旅行前に受け取る方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot necessarily wait until your return. We will check ways to collect it before your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は仕事帰りです。家への再配達より、窓口で受け取れるならその方が助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口受取を希望する理由を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am on my way home from work today. If I can collect it at the counter, that would help more than redelivery to my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain why you prefer counter collection. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保管場所と今の持出し状況を調べます。本人確認の書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check where it is held and whether it is currently out for delivery. Do you have identification documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。別の局へ行く必要があるなら、閉まる時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人書類を示し場所と閉店時刻を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If I need to go to another post office, please also tell me its closing time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show identification and ask about the location and closing time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ確認し、受取できる場所と時間をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check with the staff and explain where and when you can collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。保管期限を延ばせると思い込まず、案内された場所へ旅行前に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した方法で旅行前に受け取ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not assume the storage deadline can be extended; I will go to the advised location before my trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to collect before the trip using the confirmed method. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。受取方法が確定してからご移動ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11232-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please wait until the collection method is confirmed before heading there.
